description.value: SYU Japanese Cuisine & Sushi Bar is an upscale Japanese restaurant in Richmond offering a sushi bar, à la carte dining, omakase experiences, and lunch sets. The restaurant blends traditional Japanese culinary artistry with contemporary elegance and is noted by customers for exceptionally fresh seafood and an authentically Japanese atmosphere. It sits near the River Road corridor, making it a potential destination stop for cyclists exploring the Richmond waterfront area.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 16m; rack at 19m; rack at 45m; rack at 48m; rack at 51m; rack at 76m; rack at 87m.
